title: Common analysis Finding
description: Editor assistance derived from the canonical ThreatForge common analysis Finding model.

schema_version.description: Canonical common analysis Finding schema version.

id.description: Stable canonical common analysis Finding identifier.

title.description: Canonical human-readable single-line title distinct from the threat scenario.

analysis_record_id.description: Exactly one originating governed methodology-specific Analysis Record identifier.

affected_subjects.description: Governed Base Analysis or Functional Requirement subjects affected by the Finding.

kind.description: Canonical model owning the affected subject identity.

id.description: Canonical identity preserved from the owning source model.

threat_scenario.description: Concrete threat scenario represented by the Finding.

expected_consequences.description: Expected consequences of the threat scenario.

rationale_or_evidence.description: Supporting rationale or evidence preserved by the common Finding.

review_state.description: Explicitly recorded review state that is never inferred from Finding content.
